kpi.purpose: Monumental tabular number at the head of every KPI card. Always with .tnum.

h1.purpose: One per page, Nunito extrabold, tight tracking.

h2.purpose: Section/card headers (chart, top products, empty states).

body.purpose: Descriptions, table cells, helper and empty-state copy. Spanish voseo voice.

label-mono.purpose: The only uppercase in the system: KPI labels, rail kicker, table headers.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The single easing for rise-in and dough-grow; soft dough deceleration.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Mount animation for every card, section and page block; stagger siblings 60–80ms via animationDelay (dashboard caps at 380ms).

motion.name: dough-grow
motion.value: 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; from scaleX(0.92) / opacity 0.4; transform-origin: left center
motion.purpose: Dough-curve container grows horizontally like dough on mount.

motion.name: pulse-dot
motion.value: 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; scale(1)→scale(1.45), opacity 1→0.55; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center
motion.purpose: Halo of the live chart point on today's zero — the system's heartbeat.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.value: 0.35s ease on body background-color and color
motion.purpose: Light/dark switch cross-fade; only global transition on the page chrome.

components.css: @keyframes rise-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .ds-kpi { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--borde); background: var(--tarjeta); color: var(--tinta); padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-nunito), ui-rounded, sans-serif; animation: rise-in 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } .ds-kpi__bar { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 4px; background: var(--melaza); } .ds-kpi__label { font-family: var(--font-plex-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--suave); } .ds-kpi__value { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi__unit { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--suave); } .ds-kpi__sub { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--suave); } .ds-kpi:hover { border-color: var(--borde); }

components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-nunito), ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-rail__kicker { font-family: var(--font-plex-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--suave); } .ds-rail__sep { color: var(--borde); } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-pill--done { background: var(--pistacho); color: #33463a; } :host-context(.dark) .ds-pill--done, .dark .ds-pill--done { color: #dff0e2; } .ds-pill--now { background: var(--ambar); color: #3b2417; } :host-context(.dark) .ds-pill--now, .dark .ds-pill--now { color: #2b1a10; } .ds-pill--next { background: var(--melaza); color: #5c4a3d; } :host-context(.dark) .ds-pill--next, .dark .ds-pill--next { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melaza) 40%, transparent); color: var(--suave); }

components.name: Dough Curve
components.description: Signature area chart: serie-a gradient fill, amber stroke, pulsing live dot on the last point. Static SVG stand-in for the Recharts component.
components.css: @keyframes pulse-dot { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(1.45); opacity: 0.55; } } @keyframes dough-grow { from { transform: scaleX(0.92); opacity: 0.4; } to { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; } } .ds-curve { height: 160px; transform-origin: left center; animation: dough-grow 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } .ds-curve__halo { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: pulse-dot 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-curve, .ds-curve__halo { animation: none !important; } }

narrative.overview:
Every surface is dough-toned: the page floor is raw masa, cards are flour-white sheets, and the three pastel stage colors (rosa, pistacho, melaza) encode what each number means in the bakery's day — sales, profit, cost. Time is dough: every temporal series rises like a fermentation curve, and the workday is a rail of stage pills (done → now → next). The system refuses the generic SaaS dashboard (light gray floor, corporate blue, interchangeable cards) on both aesthetic and product grounds: the owner is a baker, not an analyst, and the interface should feel like the counter of their shop.

Density is calm and generous: one accent family, one mono voice for machine labels, one rounded humanist face for everything else. The single saturated color in the entire system is oven amber, and it is spent only where the user can act or where the system is currently alive. Everything else is pastel or ink.
keyCharacteristics: Pastel stage roles: rosa = sales/income, pistacho = profit/good, melaza = cost; amber = action and aliveness only.
Border-only elevation — depth comes from masa/tarjeta tone step plus a 1px border, never from shadows.
Monumental tabular KPI figures (32px extrabold) under tiny uppercase mono labels.
One motion family: soft rise, horizontal dough grow, slow live pulse; all disabled under reduced motion.
Spanish UI copy with voseo forms, es-BO number formatting, ▲/▼ deltas.

rules.name: The Amber Rule
rules.body: ambar is the only saturated color in the system and is spent exclusively on: things you can click, the keyboard focus ring, the text caret, the chart's live point and stroke, and the "now" stage. If a screen has more than ~3 amber elements, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Stage-Color Law
rules.body: rosa = ingresos, pistacho = ganancia, melaza = costos. These meanings are fixed system-wide; never reassign a pastel to a different semantic to "make a card pop."

rules.name: The One-Floor Rule
rules.body: Page backgrounds are always masa. Cards are always tarjeta. There is no third surface tone and no colored page background.

rules.name: The Mono Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for Plex Mono micro-labels and the DEMO badge. Nunito never goes uppercase.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number the user compares column-down or across states — KPI values, table units/revenues, axis ticks, license input — gets .tnum (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). The body default disables tnum globally; opt in per element.

rules.name: The Delta Rule
rules.body: Period-over-period change renders as ▲ 12,5% / ▼ 3,2% / • 0,0%, colored verde when up, alerta when down. Never a bare sign, never a colored pill.

rules.name: The Border-Only Rule
rules.body: No card, button, or input carries a box-shadow. Depth is a two-step tonal ladder — masa floor → tarjeta card — sealed by a 1px borde line. The only translucency device in the system is the sticky header's bg-tarjeta/95 + backdrop-blur-sm. Focus is a ring (2px ambar outline, 2px offset, 4px radius), not elevation.

dos: Do build every card as tarjeta on masa with a 1px borde and 16px radius — the whole system is that one recipe.
Do keep amber to actions, focus, caret, and the live chart point; measure a new screen by counting its amber elements.
Do label every number group with a Plex Mono uppercase micro-label (10–11px, tracking ≥0.1em, suave).
Do put .tnum on every comparable figure and format with es-BO (bs(), usd(), pct(), deltaPct() helpers).
Do reuse stage roles for any new metric: rosa sales-side, pistacho good-side, melaza cost-side; new series come from serie-a/b/c.
Do enter new page blocks with rise-in and stagger siblings ~60–80ms; keep total stagger under 400ms.
Do write UI copy in Spanish with the shipped voseo voice ("Subí", "Conectá", "mirá") and honest empty/error sentences.
donts: Don't add box-shadow to cards, buttons, or inputs — the border-only rule is absolute.
Don't introduce a new saturated hue, a dark "premium" card, or a colored page background.
Don't set Nunito in uppercase, or Plex Mono for sentences/numbers-that-aren't-labels.
Don't color a stage pill or role bar by taste — the rosa/pistacho/melaza meanings are fixed.
Don't use amber text on pastel or masa surfaces for "emphasis"; use tinta or suave.
Don't animate under reduced motion, and don't ship an infinite animation other than the live-dot pulse.
Don't fabricate customers, testimonials, or decorative data — PRODUCT.md forbids invented evidence.
